integrity: The displayed coefficient follows from exact face-altitude and Gram-density formulas plus a convergent volume integral; seeded finite computations are supplemental.
scientific_limitations: Three independent, uniform unit-sphere generators in Euclidean dimension three only.
A leading near-optimal inradius asymptotic, exact triple-integral tail, and conditional limit; no closed-form full CDF or higher-order coefficient.
